summary: White, airy page of one repeated row: a centered title over a wide rounded photo, then nine alternating text and badge rows (certifications first, then controls), a three-card tips row and a small closing offer. Needs a badge or document cover per row and one short paragraph with a link per control.

sections.note: centered heading, two-line lead and one pill button; the page head ends in a wide rounded photo band about 440 px tall
full-width rounded photo under the head, no text on it

each row about 715 px: a two-line heading, one or two sentences and one underlined link on one side; a certificate badge, graphic or report cover on the other; sides alternate. Four rows are certificates and reports (the third offers a request form), five are controls (layers, sign-in, network, uptime, disclosure program)
heading Your online safety, then three text cards (account safety, phishing, notice board) each with a link
small closing offer: heading with a line and two buttons
